newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia palm oil ends lower, awaits crop report.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm oil ends lower, awaits crop report.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices were lower at close as players liquidated on lack of leads. Selling was seen mainly from commission houses with prices moving in a tight range ahead of the week and Ivan Wong report. Trading activity was reduced.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - The market was quiet, with players awaiting export business, performance of soyoil in Chicago. Interest was seen among nearby CPOs and selected products.
By the close of the market, December futures contract was down 11 ringgit at 1,156 ringgit ($462.40) a tonne.
The market will trade in the range of between 1,130 and 1,180 ringgit for December futures contract next week.

The market is expected to trade around these levels, with traders saying the near-term trend depends a lot on the performance of Chicago soyoil futures, weather conditions, export business and other fundamentals.
Trading turned cautious ahead of the weekend and turnover was 1,722 lots against 2,518 lots on Thursday.
The physical sector saw dealing among nearby CPOs and selected products.
Trading also slowed down with October (south) crude palm oil offering at 1,187.50 ringgit a tonne after trading from 1,185 to 1,190. October (south) was bid at 1,182.50.
Oct (central) was offered at 1,155 with bids at 1,145 after making early sales done at 1,150 and 1,140. Oct (north) saw offers at 1,140 and bids at 1,130.
Nov (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,190 ringgit with bids at 1,180.
Nov (central) saw offers at 1,170 and bids at 1,160 and Dec (south) at 1,190 with bids at 1,180.
In refined palm oil market, Oct RBD palm oil was offered at $512.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia and Nov/Dec at $507.50 and Jan/Feb/Mch at $510. Oct was traded at $510.
Oct palm olein saw offers at $547.50, Nov/Dec at $535 and Jan/Feb/Mch at $537.50. October was traded at $542.50 and $545.
Oct RBD palm stearin was offered at $382.50, Nov/Dec at $392.50 and Nov/Dec palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $332.50. - Tan Lee Lee (603-230-8911) ($1=2.5000 ringgit).
